review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production run of cs_app::objectives::recover_retail_objectives on zbd/c1c/m01 (lifecycle-census.json). Claim is implemented only. MEASURED: the engine image's loader and per-pass objective code were read statically at the addresses cited in docs/findings/2026-10-12-m01-b-obj-2-objective-lifecycle-count-identity-cues.md; the recovery then read the mission's 58 OBJECTIVE<N> blocks and recovered 52 dormancy-family fields (BEGIN_DORMANT and WAKE_OBJECTIVE_WHEN_I_SLEEP), 9 INACTIVE_COMPLETION_COUNT fields, 5 IDENTITY fields and 41 sound-group fields, leaving 192 fields of the other families unrecovered and zero in the four families this task owns. LIMITS OF WHAT WAS MEASURED, each recorded in the same finding: (1) the threshold default is the engine's RESOLVED stage count; the recovery keeps the declared count as its upper bound and marks it so; (2) the bit the stage checker tallies (+0x24 bit 0x4, counted when CLEAR) is the condition family's meaning and stays unmeasured - the model takes the caller's count and never invents it; (3) the IDENTITY message element is never read by the objective path (the briefing reader is a separate site) and is kept verbatim only; (4) the dormant-only wake extras (+0x5e0 RESET_TIMER, the +0xd8 completed-link) belong to other families and are documented but not modelled; (5) cue emission is modelled, audio playback is not; (6) no original executable was run - this is a static reading. `unknowns` is empty because every unresolved item is a limit on the claim rather than an unresolved measurement: every field of the four owned families resolved. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
